name: ai-pet
description: Mac 桌面宠物 — Electron + Live2D + 语音对话
author: ai-pet

scripts.dist: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false env -u NODE_OPTIONS electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.test:parse: npx --yes tsx -e "import { parseReplyTags } from './src/shared/parseReply.ts'; import { ReplyStreamParser } from './src/shared/parseReplyStream.ts'; const r = parseReplyTags('[emotion:happy][motion:Wave]你好'); if (r.emotion!=='happy'||r.motion!=='Wave'||r.text!=='你好') { console.error(r); process.exit(1)}; const p=new ReplyStreamParser(); const chunks=['[emotion:ha','ppy][mot','ion:Dance]跳','舞呀']; let sawE=false,sawM=false; for (const c of chunks){ const d=p.push(c); if(d.emotionChanged&&d.emotion==='happy')sawE=true; if(d.motionChanged&&d.motion==='Dance')sawM=true;} const f=p.finish(); if(!sawE||!sawM||f.emotion!=='happy'||f.motion!=='Dance'||!f.text.includes('跳舞')){console.error('stream fail',{sawE,sawM,f});process.exit(1)}; console.log('parse ok', r); console.log('stream ok', f);"

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: 需要麦克风权限以进行语音对话
